The major historical battle that took place in Palembang was the **Battle of Palembang (1942)**, which was part of the Pacific theatre during World War II. This battle occurred from **February 13-15, 1942**, and **ended on February 15, 1942** when Japanese forces captured the city and its oil refineries.

So to answer your question directly: The Battle at Choo Hoey's birthplace ended on **February 15, 1942**.
